'''Piedmont Natural Gas Wayne County Lateral''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Clayton, Johnston County, North Carolina to H.F. Lee Energy Complex, near Goldsboro, Wayne County, North Carolina.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.wral.com/archive/10704414/|title=wral.com|website=wral.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/magazine/2009/december-2009-vol-236-no-12/projects/piedmont-to-build-pipeline-compression-facilities-for-power-plant|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
